description.en: The ID of the stream collaboration. You can obtain the value of this parameter based on the value of `Coid` that is returned by the `ApplyCoordinationForMonitoring` operation.

description.zh: 终端用户的用户名。管理员侧不需要。
description.en: The name of the convenience user account. If you initiate the request as an administrator, you do not need to specify this parameter.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~436773~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 云电脑连接任务ID。首次请求时不需要填写。首次请求如果没有返回Ticket，则后续请求根据首次返回的`TaskId`填写。
description.en: The ID of the cloud computer connection task. The first time you initiate the request, you do not need to specify the ID of the cloud computer connection task. If no ticket is returned after you initiate the first request, you must specify the value of taskId that is returned for the first request in the subsequent request.

The type of the user.

Set the value to TENANT\_ADMIN.

- The value of

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->

  TENANT\_ADMIN

  <!-- -->

  specifies an administrator.
